Fixes the light title bar on Windows and the unreadable percentage on finished downloads.

## 🐛 Fixed

- **The percentage on a finished download's progress bar was still unreadable.** The v1.2.1 fix never worked on desktop JDownloader. JD reads only its own keys from `cfg/laf/FlatDarkLaf.json` and drops the rest, so `ProgressBar.selectionForeground` did nothing. JD fills the bar in the table's text colour and FlatLaf draws its light label on top. The percentage now sits next to the bar (`progresscolumntextposition: RIGHT`), in normal light text on the dark row. The raw key is gone, and a test makes sure no other key JD ignores slips back into the theme. (#34)
- **The title bar stayed white on Windows.** On Windows JD keeps the native title bar by default, and that one ignores the theme. The Windows installer now also sets `windowdecorationenabled: true` in the theme file, so FlatLaf draws a dark title bar with the menu inside it. Linux and macOS keep their native window decorations. (#34)

## Notes

- To pick this up, close JDownloader, run the installer again and start JDownloader. If you installed by hand on Windows, add `"windowdecorationenabled": true` to `cfg/laf/FlatDarkLaf.json`.
